nodes.description: Mapping of reflection balances per address; mutated in _transferStandard and _takeTeam.
Mapping of token balances per address (declared but unused in this contract).
Nested mapping of owner/spender allowances; written by _approve and read by allowance/transferFrom.
Mapping flagging addresses excluded from fees; gates fee logic in _transfer.
Blacklist mapping of sniper bot addresses; blocks transfers in _transfer and is set by nonosquare/delBot.
Mapping of per-address cooldown timestamps, enforced using block.timestamp in _transfer.
Total reflection supply; reduced in _reflectFee and read by _getCurrentSupply.
Accumulated fee tokens; incremented in _reflectFee.
Reflection fee rate, reset in _transfer before fee computation.
Team/marketing fee rate, set to 10 in _transfer before fee computation.
Fee wallet 1; used as the access check subject in manualswap and manualsend.
Fee wallet 2; receives ETH in sendETHToFee.set
Uniswap V2 router address set in openTrading and used in swapTokensForEth.
Liquidity pair address created in openTrading; used as transfer source/sink checks in _transfer.
Trading enable flag set at the end of openTrading.
Reentrancy guard flag toggled by the lockTheSwap modifier.
Flag enabling automatic contract balance swaps; set in openTrading.
Flag enabling the cooldown check; set by setCooldownEnabled and openTrading.
Maximum transaction amount, enforced in _transfer and updated in openTrading.
Ownable owner address; controls onlyOwner gated functions.
Public ERC20 transfer; forwards _msgSender(), recipient and amount to _transfer.
Public ERC20 transferFrom; calls _transfer then _approve to decrement allowance.
Public ERC20 approve; calls _approve for _msgSender() and spender.
Core transfer routine: fee selection, bot/cooldown checks, maxTxAmount check, swap-and-send ETH to fee wallets, then _tokenTransfer.
Swaps contract tokens for ETH through the router under lockTheSwap; uses block.timestamp as deadline.
Sends contract ETH to _feeAddrWallet2 via a low-level-style transfer (unchecked external call).
Owner-only setup: sets router/pair, approves, adds liquidity with all ETH, enables swaps/cooldown, sets _maxTxAmount and tradingOpen.
Restricted to _feeAddrWallet1; swaps the whole contract token balance for ETH.
Restricted to _feeAddrWallet1; sends the whole contract ETH balance to the fee wallet.
Internal dispatcher used by _transfer that calls _transferStandard.
Applies reflection accounting: debits sender, credits recipient, takes team cut, reflects fee.
Mints the team reflection share to the contract address.
Reduces _rTotal and increases _tFeeTotal by the reflected fee.
Computes token and reflection amounts for a transfer using _getTValues, _getRate and _getRValues.
Returns reflection supply divided by token supply using _getCurrentSupply.
Returns current reflection and token supply, with a guard branch on the reflection rate.
Owner-only setter toggling cooldownEnabled.
Owner-only loop adding addresses to the bots blacklist.
Owner-only function removing a single address from the bots blacklist.
Contract constructor: sets fee wallets, allocates the full reflection supply to the deployer and marks fee exempt addresses.
ERC20 balanceOf; converts reflection balance through tokenFromReflection.
Converts a reflection amount into a token amount using _getRate.
Owner-only function that sets _owner to the zero address.
Caller-controlled address used for transfer origin, allowance owner and fee-wallet checks.
Timestamp used for the cooldown gate and as swap/liquidity deadlines.
External ETH transfer to _feeAddrWallet2 inside sendETHToFee/limit; external call executes before transfer state finalization.
External call to uniswapV2Router.swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens with amountOutMin set to 0.
External call adding liquidity with the contract's whole ETH balance, followed by state assignments.
Transfer state updates (via _tokenTransfer) executed after external swap/ETH calls in _transfer, enabling re-entrant accounting.
Sender address parameter of _transfer.
Recipient address parameter of _transfer.
Transfer amount parameter of _transfer.
Contract balance snapshot passed to swapTokensForEth in _transfer.
Contract ETH balance snapshot passed to sendETHToFee in _transfer.
Array of addresses to blacklist in nonosquare.
Token amount parameter of _transferStandard.
Address to un-blacklist in delBot.

edges.reason: _msgSender() supplies the from address for value transfers routed into _transfer.
manualswap authorization compares _msgSender() with _feeAddrWallet1.
manualsend authorization compares _msgSender() with _feeAddrWallet1.
Cooldown gate reads and writes cooldown[to] using block.timestamp, making the receipt path timestamp dependent.
block.timestamp is passed as the router swap deadline.
block.timestamp is passed as the addLiquidityETH deadline.
from parameter feeds _transfer checks and accounting.
to parameter feeds _transfer checks and accounting.
amount parameter is compared against _maxTxAmount and transferred.
tAmount parameter is consumed by _getValues and reflected accounting.
bots_ array provides the addresses iterated in nonosquare.
Each bots_ entry is written as true into the bots blacklist mapping.
notbot parameter selects the blacklist entry removed in delBot.
delBot writes false into bots[notbot].
contractTokenBalance is the tokenAmount passed to swapTokensForEth.
contractETHBalance is the amount passed to sendETHToFee.
_transferStandard debits and credits _rOwned entries.
_takeTeam increases _rOwned of the contract address.
_reflectFee reduces _rTotal by rFee.
_reflectFee increases _tFeeTotal by tFee.
_transfer writes cooldown[to] = block.timestamp + 30 seconds.
_transfer resets _feeAddr1 before fee computation.
_transfer sets _feeAddr2 to 10 before fee computation.
_transfer enforces the amount <= _maxTxAmount constraint.
setCooldownEnabled writes the cooldownEnabled flag.
openTrading sets tradingOpen to true.
openTrading sets swapEnabled to true.
openTrading reduces _maxTxAmount to 5000000 * 10**9.
openTrading assigns the Uniswap V2 router address.
openTrading creates and stores the Uniswap pair address.
openTrading approves the router through _approve, writing _allowances.
The external ETH transfer to the fee wallet executes before transfer state finalization.
The router swap external call executes before _tokenTransfer updates balances.
transfer invokes _transfer.
transferFrom invokes _transfer.
_transfer ends by calling _tokenTransfer.
_transfer calls swapTokensForEth when swapEnabled and not inSwap.
_transfer calls sendETHToFee when the contract holds ETH.
_transfer calls balanceOf(address(this)) to size the swap.
balanceOf delegates conversion to tokenFromReflection.
tokenFromReflection reads the rate from _getRate.
_tokenTransfer dispatches to _transferStandard.
_transferStandard calls _takeTeam for the team share.
_transferStandard calls _reflectFee for the reflection share.
_getValues reads the current rate through _getRate.
_getRate obtains supplies from _getCurrentSupply.
manualswap calls swapTokensForEth with the contract balance.
manualsend calls sendETHToFee with the contract ETH balance.
swapTokensForEth performs the router swap external call.
sendETHToFee performs the external ETH transfer to the fee wallet.
openTrading performs the addLiquidityETH external call.
openTrading depends on the router swap path configured for the contract.
A malicious fee wallet or fallback can re-enter _transfer during the ETH transfer.
The router/pair callback during the swap can re-enter _transfer token accounting.
The liquidity pair callback during addLiquidityETH can re-enter openTrading before flags are set.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter from is only meaningful as part of _transfer's check and accounting logic.
Parameter to is only meaningful as part of _transfer's check and accounting logic.
Parameter amount is only meaningful inside _transfer's maxTxAmount and fee logic.
Local contractTokenBalance exists solely to feed swapTokensForEth.
Local contractETHBalance exists solely to feed sendETHToFee.
Parameter bots_ is used only by nonosquare's blacklist loop.
Parameter tAmount is used only by _transferStandard's accounting branches.
Parameter notbot is used only by delBot's blacklist removal.
